help.desc:
**Hello :wave:**, I'm **%s**!
I'm the music bot your server needs! I can play songs from **Spotify**, **Soundcloud**, **Twitch** and [much more](https://kenabot.xyz)!

**Commands**
You can see information about all my commands **[here](https://kenabot.xyz/commands)** or by clicking on the button below!

**Premium/Donations**
The **[KenaBot for Donors](https://kenabot.xyz/premium)** version will give you access to new features and enhancements to the bot, such as **24/7**, **audio effects** and a **web player**!!!!
[Click here to learn more](https://kenabot.xyz/premium)

**Add me to your server**
You can add me to as many servers as you want by clicking **[here](https://discord.com/api/oauth2/authorize?client_id=%s&permissions=3534272&scope=bot%20applications.commands)** or the button!

**Support server**
On my support server you will find all kinds of help and more information about me, you can join by clicking **[here](https://kenabot.xyz/support)** or on the button!

If you have any questions about the bot and its configuration, you can go to my **[support server](https://kenabot.xyz/soporte)** or check my **[web page](https://kenabot.xyz)**.

If you don't see your language you can join my [support server](https://kenabot.xyz/soporte) and contribute as a translator!

embed.title: Embed color configuration

Open the menu to choose the embed color that will be shown in all bot messages.

This menu has only default colors, if you want to use a custom color you can go to my [dashboard web](https://kenabot.xyz/dashboard).
